hints.title: Round Trip Baseline Sum
hints.text: All nuts except the first one visited require a round trip from the tree to the nut and back.

hints.title: First Nut Distance Savings
hints.text: Visiting nut i first saves dist(nut, tree) minus dist(nut, squirrel) compared to the tree-to-nut round trip.

hints.title: Maximum Savings Deduction
hints.text: Sum two times dist(nut, tree) for all nuts. Find the maximum of dist(nut, tree) minus dist(nut, squirrel) across all nuts, and subtract that maximum savings from the total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all starting choices with nested path simulations is redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass computes total round-trip distance and locates the maximal first-nut saving.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Manhattan distance formulation and frame the first nut as maximizing savings.
